verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents instant virtual card issuance for team members with spend limits and controls (jeeves-docs-19, jeeves-docs-20, jeeves-docs-23, jeeves-docs-34), which supports scoping cards by spend limit/purpose. However, there's no explicit evidence of purpose-tagging (e.g., 'ad spend' category) or single-vendor lock/merchant-restriction controls beyond generic spend limits. Missing for 10: explicit vendor-lock or merchant-category restriction features, and independent/hands-on confirmation of instant creation flow.
